name: Level of Detail for Volumetric Terrain
aliases: Level of Detail (LOD) for Volumetric Terrain
definition: A fast and GPU-friendly level of detail algorithm for real-time rendering of volumetric terrain using arbitrary volumetric models, which does not require preprocessing and handles infinite procedural terrain.
summary: Level of Detail for Volumetric Terrain is a real-time algorithm that generates geometry on the fly to efficiently render vast, complex volumetric terrain without preprocessing.
